courseName: Text, kultur och samhälle: engelska i samtiden
versionEvidence: Official course plan ENALS1/20262 states it was approved 2026-02-17 and applies from Autumn 2026.
content: The course studies relations between language, literature, culture, media and society, emphasizing cultural negotiation during social change across geographic and historical contexts. Teaching uses theoretical reading, seminars, and oral and written assignments.
learningGoals: Summarize and evaluate texts on language, literature, and cultural theory.
Explain and critically assess theories of language, literature, and culture.
Develop independent theoretical reasoning from texts.
Write and speak English in a polished, analytical, and well-structured way.

versionEvidence: KTH's official course catalogue identifies the linked course syllabus as A31P1A (HT 2026–).
content: The studio introduces urban planning theory and practice through a large-scale project. Students apply practical and theoretical urban design knowledge across spatial, social, ecological, technical, and economic aspects, and compare international examples with Swedish planning.
learningGoals: Explain interactions between the city, public space, and urban systems.
Apply and develop urban strategies in design projects.
Recognize sustainability questions and urban complexity in an international context.
Communicate design strategies through oral and graphic presentations and reflect on learning.
